razonamiento: The whiteboard shows Levels Beyond's Media to Cloud workflow. Video files are uploaded to an S3 bucket, which triggers AWS Step Functions. Step Functions orchestrates Elemental MediaConvert (transcoding proxy generation), metadata extraction into DynamoDB, Rekognition (celebrity/content detection), and Transcribe (speech-to-text), which feeds Comprehend (entity extraction). Rekognition and Comprehend write metadata into DynamoDB. From DynamoDB, metadata is ingested into Reach Engine, which is hosted on EC2 and EKS (enclosed in a Reach Engine box). Per Rule 8, Reach Engine is recorded as a ThirdParty hosted component, with EC2 and EKS kept as drawn hosts, and application flows directed to Reach Engine.
nombre: Levels Beyond: Media to Cloud Orchestration with Reach Engine
